rubric_items.reason: SQL goes in PatientRepo, the rule in PatientService, router and web client are reused; no new module, endpoint, table, migration or infrastructure.
S-1, S-2 and S-3 each map to components; patient scoping, the status-only filter, zero counts, all-time window and the unchanged rest of the page are all covered.
EP-1 gives name, type, nullability, format and example for the object and both counts. EP-2 and EP-3 list only the object and give the sub-fields by reference or example.
Choices are cited or decided by A-02 and A-03, with no invented infrastructure. The label default leans on the glossary without a citation, and glossary.md is not an input.
Explains server-side counting versus the capped list, POST/PATCH carrying the field, status versus date counting, index use with no migration, and the label wording.
Short and consistently structured; front matter and body agree on components, endpoints and fields.

findings.text: The label default ("Completed", "No-show") is justified by the glossary, but no claim or component cites context/glossary.md and it is not listed in the design inputs.

cites.quote: Default: the labels use the glossary status names.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a claim citing context/glossary.md#completed and #no-show for the two labels, and list glossary.md in inputs.

findings.text: EP-2 and EP-3 list only the visitSummary object. The completed and noShow sub-fields (type, nullability, format) are given by reference to EP-1 or by example, not per field.

cites.quote: EP-3 PATCH /api/patients/:id, changed. Field `visitSummary` (object, not null, same as EP-1, known).

findings.suggested_fix: Repeat the visitSummary.completed and visitSummary.noShow field rows under EP-2 and EP-3 in the front matter.

findings.text: Impact names PatientFormPage and BookAppointmentPage as other consumers of the patient detail. The design does not say they are unaffected by the new non-null field on the web PatientDetail type.

cites.quote: Callers found by searching web/src: PatientDetailPage, PatientFormPage and BookAppointmentPage call `api.patient`

findings.suggested_fix: Add one line under CO-4 or CO-7 stating that the other api.patient callers ignore the additive field and need no change.

cites.quote: The web app talks to the API only through `web/src/api/client.ts`.
The patient page renders the appointments list with `AppointmentTable`.
The patient page's appointments section starts with the heading `Appointments`.
Logs carry method, route and error message only, never request bodies, contact details or medical

questions.text: The design defaults the Visit summary labels to the glossary status names "Completed" and "No-show". Is that wording acceptable, or does product want different labels?
